_README: Every line the AI says when the language model is not consulted -- because
it is switched off, because this exchange is below the immersion level, or
because the turn's budget ran out. Edit freely; nothing here is compiled in.
A key maps to either a plain string, or a list of variant groups. Each group
holds interchangeable 'lines' and may carry a 'when' that has to hold for the
group to be eligible. The most specific eligible group wins, and one of its
lines is chosen at random, so the same interaction stops reading identically
every time. A group with no 'when' is the catch-all and should come last.
Conditions ('when'), all optional and all answered from the turn's snapshot:
at_war      true | false                    -- are the two of us fighting
opinion     'hostile' | 'cold' | 'warm'     -- what we think of them
A condition naming a list matches if any entry does: {"strength": ["weaker", "even"]}.
Placeholders: {target} in NOT_AT_WAR, {action} in the three GENERIC keys.

NOT_AT_WAR: We would offer military aid to {target}, but they are not currently at war.

CROSS_FACTION_JOIN: Our requests crossed paths. We are now united!

CREATE_FACTION_CONFLICT: The proposed faction could not be formed because one of us is already bound by other treaties.
